structureEquivalence: Recipe and ingredient names are ignored. A bipartite graph preserves ingredient pantry totals and every per-recipe edge quantity. Recipe nodes have no solution label; exact isomorphism is tested after a safe invariant filter.

medium.nearIdenticalDefinition: at least 6/8 or 10/12 identical recipe IDs; diagnostic, not a mandatory rejection rule
